dict.string: AI Advocate uses the camera so you can photograph contracts, letters, and evidence for Lex to analyse. Photos are processed securely and saved only to your case files.
AI Advocate uses the microphone so you can record voice notes, witness statements, and Lex voice chats as evidence on your case.
AI Advocate accesses your photo library so you can upload existing photos of contracts, letters, or evidence directly to your case files.
AI Advocate saves Lex-generated documents (letter PDFs, case exports) to your photo library when you tap save.
AI Advocate uses your location during Emergency Mode to share your real-time location with your trusted contacts if you need urgent legal help.
AI Advocate uses your location during Emergency Mode to share your real-time location with your trusted contacts if you need urgent legal help.
AI Advocate can read your contacts so you can quickly add trusted friends or family as Emergency Mode contacts.
AI Advocate uses Face ID to lock your Lex Vault — your private encrypted case-evidence storage.
AI Advocate can save and access PDFs (case files, generated letters) in your Documents folder.
